protocol: P200/B200/I200/G25; 5000 attempted real evaluations per cell, including failures; four strategies, three baselines, seeds101/102/103
evidence_class: descriptive; not fresh confirmation of historical P50/perfect goal
metric: Q: mean of the ten lowest finite per-record arithmetic objective means; N: first batch-end Q strictly below paired real-only final Q at5000. Censored seeds retained.

interruption.cause: undetermined external process termination; not an algorithm rejection

selection_rule: Retain only the fully collected Chrono baseline group; replace both entire remaining baseline groups, independent of optimization quality.
